# Finito

> > Finito provides personalized bookkeeping and accounting outsourcing services for small businesses with flat-rate pricing and comprehensive financial support.

Finito is a bookkeeping and accounting outsourcing platform designed for SMBs seeking professional financial management without the overhead of in-house accounting teams. The service combines expert human support with modern accounting practices to deliver financial statements, tax preparation, and ongoing financial advisory.

- Accounting Outsourcing

- Financial Services
